entity.newDescription: Create a new {entity} in this institution.

display.description: How this institution's schedule is drawn: the standards every session falls back to.
display.intro: Colour is never the only cue on the schedule: a violation carries an icon and a label, and a locked session carries a lock, whatever you set here. These are the defaults sessions fall back to, not a replacement for those signals.
display.loadError: Could not load the display settings. Nothing has been changed.
display.readOnly: You can see these settings but not change them. Changing them needs the permission that also lets you edit session kinds.
display.modeHint: A default-behaviour bias, not a fork: this never changes what an offering is or which constraint rules exist; it only changes which offering-form fields are shown first and which constraint types the catalogue suggests. Every field and every rule stays fully reachable in both modes.
display.modeUniversity: University: offerings, required session counts, a lecturer pool
display.modeSchool: School: a subject, a weekly count, a named teacher
display.onlineHint: Online delivery is a {room}, not a flag on the session, so this decides how that fact is drawn, never whether it is true. A session is treated as online when every room it uses is virtual.
display.onlineToggle: Mark online sessions on the schedule
display.onlineColourHelp: Left empty, online sessions use a neutral outline instead of a colour.
display.sourceHead: Where a session's colour comes from
display.sourceHint: Checked sources are tried in order, most specific first. Unchecking every source makes the fallback below the only colour on the schedule.
display.fallbackColourHelp: Used when no source above supplies a colour. Left empty, chips use the neutral surface.
display.localeHint: A BCP-47 tag (e.g. {germanTag}, {britishTag}). Sets this institution's date and number format, and the interface language for everyone who has not chosen their own. Any other tag keeps its own date format and shows English. A person's setting under {myAccount} wins; leave empty to follow the browser.
display.localeError: Not a recognised locale. Try a tag like "de-DE" or "en-GB".
display.timezoneHint: An IANA zone name (e.g. {zone}): the wall clock every Session, TimeGrid and "today" is resolved against, never a person's own device. A person's own timezone under {myAccount} is display/export only and never changes any of that.
display.timezoneError: Not a recognised timezone. Try a zone name like "Europe/Berlin".
display.saveError: Could not save. Nothing has been changed.

accessDefaults.description: Whether a newly created Person is granted an access role automatically.
accessDefaults.intro: Off by default. Granting a role to somebody is normally a deliberate decision made on their own page; this setting reverses that for every new Person at once, so choose it deliberately too. Every grant it makes is marked as coming from this default, distinct from a role assigned by hand.
accessDefaults.loadError: Could not load access defaults. Nothing has been changed.
accessDefaults.readOnly: You can see this setting but not change it. Changing it needs both {tenantUpdate} and {assign}.
accessDefaults.roleLabel: Default access role for new People
accessDefaults.roleHint: Every Person created from now on will hold this role immediately, including through bulk creation, once that exists. Deleting this role while it is the default is refused; choose a different default (or None) first.
accessDefaults.saveError: Could not save. Nothing has been changed.

curriculumProgression.description: Which curriculum plan each group is currently on, and moving every eligible one forward at once.
curriculumProgression.intro: Nothing here is stored on the group: this is worked out fresh each time from the offerings a plan already created. A group with a plan that names a successor, and a later term to move into, is eligible to advance.
curriculumProgression.noneEligible: No group is eligible to advance right now.
curriculumProgression.advance: Advance {count} eligible group | Advance {count} eligible groups
curriculumProgression.advanceError: Could not advance groups. Nothing was changed.
curriculumProgression.failedRow: {count} group could not move to {plan} ({term}): {reason} | {count} groups could not move to {plan} ({term}): {reason}
curriculumProgression.emptyHint: No group has an offering created from a curriculum plan yet.

availabilityPreferences.description: Preferred teaching days and blocks, for everyone in this institution.
availabilityPreferences.notYetUsedLead: Recorded, not yet used by the scheduler.
availabilityPreferences.notYetUsed: {lead} These are stored and editable now; the constraint that makes the solver weigh them ships in a later release.
availabilityPreferences.readOnly: You can view preferences but not change them; that needs {permission}.
availabilityPreferences.daysHelp: Nothing ticked means no day preference.
availabilityPreferences.blocksHelp: Nothing ticked means no preference about the time of day.
availabilityPreferences.roomTypesHelp: Nothing ticked means no preference about the kind of room.
availabilityPreferences.weightLabel: How much this person's preference counts
availabilityPreferences.weightHelp: Most people should use the default. Raise it where somebody's constraints are genuinely harder than everyone else's, and remember it competes with the institution's other soft rules, not with them.
availabilityPreferences.emptyHint: No active people in this institution yet.

availabilityReviews.description: Unavailability people have declared for themselves, waiting on a decision.
availabilityReviews.intro: A declared window is a {hard} rule for the scheduler, so a self-declared one stays inert until it is approved here. Windows an administrator entered directly are already approved: approving your own authorized action would be ceremony, not control.
availabilityReviews.entryHint: Entered here, it is approved immediately.
availabilityReviews.modeRecurringHint: Days or blocks they never teach
availabilityReviews.daysHelp: Leave every day unticked to mean the whole week.
availabilityReviews.blocksHelp: Leave every block unticked to mean the whole day.
availabilityReviews.pendingEmpty: Nothing is waiting. Decided windows are listed below.
availabilityReviews.holidayRow: {term}: week {weeks}, away all day | {term}: weeks {weeks}, away all day

examReviews.description: Exams lecturers have asked for on their own modules, waiting on a decision.
examReviews.intro: An approved exam becomes a {locked} at the slot that was asked for: it occupies its room and its people, and no solve will move it. Approving is the moment the schedule changes, not a formality afterwards.
examReviews.capacityWarning: The preferred room seats {roomCapacity} for an exam, but this sitting is expected to need {requiredCapacity}.
examReviews.rowMeta: {kind} · {term} · week {week}, {day}, {count} block from block {block} | {kind} · {term} · week {week}, {day}, {count} blocks from block {block}
